content: Tarwa n Binyamin
Binyamin ijja-dd Bilaɛ, amenzu nnes, Acbil d wiss tnayen, Axrax d wiss třata,
Naḥu d wiss arebɛa u Rafa d wiss xemsa.
Bilaɛ tuɣa ɣares arrawen-a: Addar, Jira d Abihud,
Abicuɛa, Nuɛman, Axuxa,
Jira, Cafufan d Ḥuram.
Ina d arrawen n Aḥud. Nitni tuɣa aten d izeǧifen x ibabaten n řaǧat n imezdaɣ n Jibɛa. Nedhen i-ten ɣar Manaḥat,
aqa d Naɛman, Axiya d Jira. Netta indeh i-ten. U netta ijja-dd Ɛuzza d Axiḥud.
Caḥarayim ijja-dd iḥenjiren di temmurt n Mu’ab, awarni i umi tuɣa issuffeɣ timɣarin nnes Ḥucim d Baɛra.
Ak-d temɣart nnes Xudac ijja-dd Yubab, Ḍibya, Mica, Malkam,
Yaɛuṣ, Cabiya d Mirma. Ina tuɣa aten d arrawen nnes, izeǧifen x ibabaten n řaǧat.
Ak-d Ḥucim ijja-dd netta Abiṭub d Ilfaɛal.
Arrawen n Ilfaɛal tuɣa aten d Ɛabir, Micɛam, Camid nni ibnan Unu d Lud ak-d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen,
Bariɛa d Camaɛ. Ina tuɣa aten d izeǧifen n ibabaten n řaǧat n imezdaɣ n Ayalun. Nitni uẓẓřen x imezdaɣ n Jat.
Axiyu, Cacaq, Yarimut,
Zabadya, Ɛarad, Ɛadar,
Mixayil, Jicfa d Yuxa tuɣa aten d arrawen n Bariɛa.
Zabadya, Macullam, Ḥazki, Ḥabir,
Yicmaray, Yazliya d Yubab tuɣa aten d arrawen n Ilfaɛal.
Yaqim, Zikri, Zabdi,
Iliɛinay, Ṣillatay, Iliyil,
Ɛadaya, Baraya d Cimra tuɣa aten d arrawen n Cimi.
Yicfan, Ɛabir, Iliyil,
Ɛabdun, Zixri, Ḥanan,
Ḥananya, Ɛilam, Ɛntutiya,
Yafdiya d Fanuwil tuɣa aten d arrawen n Cacaq.
Camcaray, Caḥarya, Ɛatalya,
Yaɛracya, Iliya d Zikri tuɣa aten d arrawen n Yaruḥam.
Ina tuɣa aten d izeǧifen x ibabaten, ttwasettfen ɛlaḥsab jjadira nsen, izeǧifen i iǧan. Nitni tuɣa zeddɣen di Urcalim.
Familya n Cawul
Di Jibɛun izdeɣ babas n Jibɛun u tamɣart nnes qqaren as Maɛka.
Amenzu nnes tuɣa Ɛabdun, xenni Ṣur, Qis, Baɛal, Nadab,
Jadur, Axxiyu d Zakir.
Miqlut ijja-dd Cama. Uřa d nitni zedɣen di Urcalim ajemmaḍ n aytmatsen, jmiɛ ak-d yaytmatsen.
Nir ijja-dd Qis u Qis ijja-dd Cawul u Cawul ijja-dd Yunatan, Malkicuɛa, Abinadab d Icbaɛal.
Mmis n Yunatan tuɣa Marib-Baɛal. Marib-Baɛal ijja-dd Mixa.
Arrawen n Mixa tuɣa aten d Fitun, Malik, Tariɛ d Aḥaz.
Aḥaz ijja-dd Yahuɛadda u Yahuɛadda ijja-dd Ɛalmat, Ɛazmawet d Zimri. Zimri ijja-dd Muṣa,
u Muṣa ijja-dd Binɛa. Mmis tuɣa Rafaɛ, mmis Ilɛasa d mmis Aṣiyal.
Aṣiyal tuɣa ɣares setta n warrawen u ina d ismawen nsen: Ɛazriqam, Bukra, Ismaɛil, Caɛarya, Ɛubadya d Ḥanan. Nitni marra tuɣa aten d arrawen n Aṣiyal.
Arrawen n umas Ɛaciq tuɣa aten d Ulam, amezwaru nnes, u wiss tnayen tuɣa-t d Yaɛuc d wiss třata Ilifalaṭ.
Arrawen n Ulam tuɣa aten d iryazen, ayt n bu-teɣruḍt imeḥḍen nni imeḥḍen řqews. Nitni tuɣa ɣarsen aṭṭas n warrawen d wayyawen, s marra mya u-xemsin. Marra ina zeg warrawen n Binyamin.
